content: All verified. The deprecated `legacy_export` handler is removed and its registration is gone from `_REGISTRY`, while `ping`, `export_v2`, and `stats` all continue to work (the `stats` comment is only a question about deprecation, not an actual deprecation, so it stays). Tests pass.

arguments.summary: Removed the deprecated `legacy_export` handler function and its entry in `_REGISTRY` from `api/handlers.py`, as requested in issue #301. It was the only handler explicitly marked deprecated (since 1.2, replaced by `export_v2`, per the CHANGELOG). The ambiguous `stats` handler was kept since it is not actually deprecated. Verified the test suite passes and that `registry()` now returns only `ping`, `export_v2`, and `stats`, with all remaining handlers still functional via `handle()`.
